scope: All eval72 and sidecars; full published metadata/tools/provenance/reports; no train540 inputs or sidecars
safety: New cache root only; no overwrite, checkout/reset/worktree/config mutation. Stream regular whitelisted tar members to exclusive files; reject links, unexpected paths and traversal; Git blob SHA and declared SHA during write. No duplicate tar file.
verifier_scope: Original CLI audit hard-requires all612 and has no eval-only option. Use unchanged verify_case/scan_input/certificate functions for all72; independently supplement eval inventory, recipe/provenance/hash and split duplicate checks. Do not claim local full612 validation.

stored_full_report.role: publisher supplied additional evidence, not locally repeated

on_failure: Keep partial export/audit and unprocessed cases; no automatic retry or replacement
checks: exact eval inventory and file sizes; no train extracted
full input raw/operation/partition hashes and same metadata hashes
K/P/M/W/R/penalty/N/period header ranges and exact per-op INSERT/PROBE counts
all phases/keys/tuples/single SWITCH and complete positive partition sizes<=M
per-op joint/conditional probability positivity, uniqueness, normalization, target TV>=.20 and hot/cold>=2, mass>=.5/K
actual per-op PROBE TV>=.10, visited>=2; actual counts can tie/zero
recipe spec/build_seed/probe_seed/parent BUILD sizes and source identity
raw/op/partition duplicate check within eval and against declared train and parent manifest; train and parent raw not rescanned
offline_only: Probability certificates, future counts and stats used only by offline audit/evaluator; scheduler receives input file/public callbacks only
